pageDescription.home: View the EXIF data of your photo in your browser: the date taken, the location (latitude and longitude) on a map, the camera settings, etc. The photo is not sent to any server.
pageDescription.demo: Try {{appName}} with a sample photo, and see the EXIF data it shows: the date taken, the location on a map, the camera and its settings.
pageDescription.settings: Choose how {{appName}} writes dates and times, and whether it sends usage data. The settings are saved in your browser.
pageDescription.language: Choose the language that {{appName}} is shown in, or let it follow the language of your browser.
pageDescription.about: How {{appName}} reads your photo in your browser without sending it to any server, the usage data it collects, its source code and who develops it.
pageDescription.credits: The authors of the icons that {{appName}} uses, which are from Flaticon.

about.keptInBrowser:
This application fetches EXIF data from your file within your browser,
so the file is kept within your browser and not sent to any servers.
about.usageData:
To improve this application, it collects usage information, such as
the pages that are opened, the time they take to load and respond,
the file format of the loaded photo and the errors that occurred,
along with your IP address and the approximate location derived from it.
You can turn this off in Settings.
about.reportIssues: If you find any bugs or issues, please submit them in <issuesLink>GitHub Issues</issuesLink>.
about.sourceCode: The source code of this application is hosted on <gitHubLink>GitHub</gitHubLink>.
about.translations: Translations into other languages are welcome: see <guideLink>how to translate this application</guideLink>.
about.developedBy: This application is developed by Tomoyuki Aota.
about.photoLocationMap:
Want to see the map for the locations of many photos all at once?
Photo Location Map is available for such purposes.
